C26-F.induction: 5 x 10^5 Colon26 adenocarcinoma cells subcutaneously on the back.
C26-F.chemotherapy: Folfox on post-implantation days 7, 14 and 21: oxaliplatin 6 mg/kg, 5-fluorouracil 25 mg/kg, leucovorin 90 mg/kg.
C26-F.niacin: 150 mg/kg daily by oral gavage, dissolved in tap water, starting day 4 after tumor injection until day 28 endpoint.
C26-F.controls: Healthy controls received saline injection without cells and daily tap water. C26-F mice are tumor-bearing animals also receiving Folfox.
C26-F.SUnSET: Puromycin 40 micromol/kg intraperitoneally, 30 minutes before euthanasia.
C26-F.grasping_strength_baseline_label_conflic: Methods Sec10 calls the first measurement day 0. Source workbook explicitly records day 4, and the Figure 3 caption calls it the start of NA treatment. Preserve source day 4 for analysis and retain this discrepancy.

VCM.induction: Conditional enterocyte Msh2 knockout; spontaneous intestinal adenomas/adenocarcinomas.
VCM.niacin: 150 mg/kg daily (up to 4.5 mg/day) by oral gavage for 28 days.
VCM.controls: Age- and sex-matched untreated VCM mice and Msh2loxP/loxP healthy controls.
VCM.tumor_burden_note: Results Sec5 explicitly says heterogeneous spontaneous tumors prevented dissection of NA effects on tumor burden.

animal_pairing: Only force's explicit Mouse IDs; no cross-endpoint pairing or correlations

author_known_findings.C26-F: Reported better muscle mass/force/protein synthesis and ATP/mitochondrial content; no significant frozen respiratory-capacity improvement
author_known_findings.VCM: Reported preserved muscle mass and higher mtDNA/PGC1a; no respiratory-capacity or ATP improvement
author_known_findings.tumor: Reported no significant C26 tumor-mass effect; separate survival experiment did not improve survival
